License declaration for objc2-core-foundation and objc2-io-kit 0.3.2.

Source: https://github.com/madsmtm/objc2/blob/7b1abfd750a2cacaea71d6a56ecfb83cb7de560b/LICENSE.md

The crates omit license texts from their crates.io archives. We include this upstream declaration and choose its Apache-2.0 option for binary redistribution; the full Apache text is included in each package. No implementation code is vendored here.
